create_bill.description: Record a bill from a vendor with its lines, as a draft or received.

parameters.description: Who it's from: picked, or their ID, email address or exact name.

name.description: What the line is for. Needed when there's no item.

parameters.description: When it's due. Leave blank for Akaunting's payment terms for bills.
parameters.name: due_date

parameters.description: An order or purchase order number to show on it.
parameters.name: order_number

parameters.description: Notes printed on it.
parameters.name: notes

parameters.description: The expense category. Leave blank for the company's default.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Its currency. Leave blank for the customer's or vendor's own.
parameters.name: currency

id.description: Its ID, for other Akaunting steps

price.description: The price of one, before tax

taxes.description: The taxes on the line, by name

total.description: The line's total before tax: price times quantity, less any discount

link.description: A link to it in Akaunting

overdue.description: Whether money is still owed after its due date

account.description: The account it went into or came from

payment_method.description: How it was paid, such as Bank Transfer

remaining.description: How much is left to pay

status.description: draft, sent, viewed, received, partial, paid or cancelled

subtotal.description: Its total before tax and discounts
